# Draft:Lt. Col. John Cecil Howard-Vyse

Lieutenant-Colonel John Cecil Howard-Vyse RA (5 December 1947 – 22 September 2013), commonly known as Johnny Howard-Vyse, was a British Army officer of the Royal Artillery, and member of the Howard-Vyse family of Langton Hall, North Yorkshire.
Early life and family
John Cecil Howard-Vyse was born on 5 December 1947, the second son of Lieutenant-General Sir Edward Dacre Howard-Vyse KBE CB MC DL (1905–1992) and Mary Bridget Willoughby (1910–2003). The Howard-Vyse family are a longstanding Yorkshire landed gentry family associated with Langton Hall near Malton.
He had two siblings; Richard Edward Howard-Vyse (1941–2009) and Elizabeth Howard-Vyse.
He went to Eagle House Prep school and Wellington College, Berkshire before going to the Royal Military Academy, Sandhurst in 1966.
Military career
John Howard-Vyse served in the British Army with the Royal Artillery and attained the rank of lieutenant-colonel. He served in the 49th Field Regiment RA, 27 Field Regiment RA, and 1 Royal Horse Artillery, in the UK, Germany, and Gibraltar. He also attended the Royal Naval Staff College at Greenwich. He retired in 2003.
Later life
John Howard-Vyse was a qualified Yachtmaster, and sailed with the Ocean Youth Trust North.
Personal life
In 1972, Howard-Vyse married Jennifer Anne ("Jenny") Collin, daughter of Major-General Geoffrey de Egglesfield Collin CB MC DL.
They had three children; Georgina, James, and Victoria.
Death
Howard-Vyse died at his home on 22 September 2013, aged 65.
